faq.a: Marjani is associated with Arabic. Marjani is Arabic مَرْجَانِيّ (Marjāniyy), the nisba of مَرْجَان (Marjān), meaning 'of coral; belonging to coral'. The source gloss 'Exalted, Noble, Radiant' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as marjan and marjana.
